candidates.name: Pollinations (Classic image API)
candidates.free_tier_limits: No signup documented; approximately one image per 45 seconds; one model; best-effort with no uptime guarantee.
candidates.license: See the current Pollinations project terms; not assumed here.
candidates.commercial_use: Unverified; review the current terms before commercial use.
candidates.watermark: JPEG output includes a small logo according to the API docs.
quality_limitations: Single model; not suitable for production texture sets.
No texture maps, normal maps, roughness maps or meshes.
candidates.data_handling: Requests leave the machine; review the provider policy.
notes: Suitable only as a labelled concept-image experiment.

candidates.name: Stability AI API
candidates.license: Stability AI API terms; model licences vary.
candidates.commercial_use: Permitted only under the paid API terms.
quality_limitations: Trial credit is not an ongoing free allowance.
candidates.data_handling: Hosted request; review the data policy.
notes: Classified trial_only in the provider policy; refused by free-only mode.

candidates.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
candidates.free_tier_limits: Free accounts receive no monthly credits; purchase required.
candidates.commercial_use: Depends on the selected model and provider.
quality_limitations: Paid inference, so it does not satisfy free-only mode.
notes: Included to show that a familiar brand is not a free allowance.

candidates.name: Stable Diffusion (local, via ComfyUI or a compatible runtime)
candidates.free_tier_limits: No hosted free API. Runs locally after the user installs a runtime and obtains model weights.
candidates.license: CreativeML Open RAIL-M (model); runtime licences differ.
candidates.commercial_use: Permitted by the RAIL-M licence subject to its use restrictions; verify the exact model card.
candidates.attribution_required: Per the model card and runtime licence.
candidates.watermark: No mandatory watermark in the base model.
candidates.rate_limits: None hosted; limited by local hardware.
candidates.hardware_requirements: A dedicated GPU with sufficient VRAM is typically needed; the documented 16 GB / integrated-GPU machine may not be practical. Not measured here.
quality_limitations: Seamless material output requires additional setup and validation; not demonstrated by this project.
candidates.data_handling: Local; prompts and images stay on the machine.
notes: Not installed. No model weights were downloaded.
Procedural Blender output must never be labelled AI-generated.

candidates.commercial_use: Follow the runtime and model licences.
candidates.attribution_required: Per the runtime and model licences.
candidates.hardware_requirements: GPU/VRAM dependent; not validated on this machine.
quality_limitations: Requires manual workflow authoring and validation.
notes: Not installed. This project does not download models.
